description: #185: capture-route.ts (the team standard review-capture) took only a fullPage screenshot. A fullPage shot renders position:fixed/sticky ONCE at its document position, so a fixed header/footer/nav floats to the WRONG place in the tall image — the reviewer never sees what the user sees on screen, so an overlap can pass review. Fix: each viewport now also gets vp-top (first screen, viewport-sized, no fullPage), vp-bottom (a viewport shot scrolled to the very bottom scrollTo(0,sh), taken whenever the page is taller than one screen sh>ih, so a fixed bottom-0 is seen where it overlaps the LAST content), and a PRINTED list of every fixed/sticky element (count + tag/class + box, read from the live computed style — not class-name guessing) so the overlap can't hide from the eye. The full shot + its filename are unchanged (backward-compatible); --route/--user/--viewports flags unchanged. Ran LIVE (--route /v2 --user default --viewports 393, FE ff72ae7, test-env booted): 3 shots at correct sizes (full 786x4064, vp-top/vp-bottom 786x1704=393x852@dsf2); probe found the bottom tab nav (fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0, box [0,758 393x94]) + a 0x0 portal anchor; and the double-evidence VISIBLY shows the deception — in full the fixed nav renders mid-image (~y800, covering the ดวงสมพงค์ cards), in vp-top/vp-bottom it is correctly pinned to screen-bottom over the LAST content and clears it with a gap (goo read the PNGs). HISTORY (บอง #123): the first cut gated the second shot on sh>1.5x-viewport while the skip line still printed 'same as vp-top' — a 1.0-1.5x page went unphotographed yet the tool affirmed nothing was missed = a false-green in the very tool built to kill false-greens; the 1.5 threshold was DROPPED (shoot whenever sh>ih, scroll to bottom, message true only when sh<=ih). This is a SCREENSHOT ARTIFACT not a UI bug (the nav is a legit fixed bottom-0) — the tool makes the misplacement visible; 'tool works, no UI bug' is the correct result, no bug-hunt. verify-real-path finding reported (not silently adjusted): the plan cited a fixed top-0 header but live /v2 has NO fixed top-0 header — the only fixed element is the bottom nav; so the demo is the bottom nav, not a header. Bug-class sweep (#167/#176 trap): every harness screenshot call grep'd — run-bg-continuity.ts:42 fullPage is INTENTIONAL (samples BG seam down the whole scroll; viewport would break it) so left untouched; capture.ts:78 + pixel-anchor.ts:88 already viewport; run-verdict-color.ts:24 is an element shot — only capture-route had the bug. Sibling stale-comment (pixel-anchor.ts:42 docblock said 'fullPage frames' while code is viewport — same lying-header class) fixed in a separate docs() commit, comment only. gate_layer=harness/tooling + rendered-pixel.
